notes: One portion of 12, without the cream or custard. Assumptions: the brandy goes into the hot syrup off the heat, so ~85 % of its alcohol energy is kept (USDA retention for alcohol stirred into a hot liquid off the heat), which is ~250 kcal for the tart; pecans taken over walnuts (walnuts would be 37 kcal less for the whole tart). The tart weighs ~1.55 kg after baking and soaking, ~316 kcal / 100 g. No brandy-tart figure turned up. Compared against the closest Cape pudding: malva pudding at 295 (The Menu), 317 (Woolworths) and 337 (Snowflake) kcal / 100 g (FatSecret ZA). Ours sits in that band, at a 130 g portion.
